description: This Java class implements a Spring Batch Tasklet responsible for posting interest to savings accounts in a multithreaded manner, managing data fetching, batching, and thread execution for interest posting.

classes.name: PostInterestForSavingTasklet
classes.description: A Spring Batch Tasklet that manages multithreaded interest posting for savings accounts, including data retrieval, batching, and thread management.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method invoked by Spring Batch to perform interest posting, initializes thread pool, retrieves savings data, and manages the processing queue.

methods.name: postInterest
methods.description: Handles batching of savings accounts, creates and submits tasks to the thread pool, manages data fetching and queueing during processing.

methods.name: safeSubList
methods.description: Safely extracts a sublist from a list, handling boundary conditions.

methods.name: checkCompletion
methods.description: Checks if all submitted thread tasks have completed successfully.
